charts.title: GJ 9827 d: orbits around GJ 9827
charts.description: The orbits of GJ 9827's planets in this map from above, to scale, with GJ 9827 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Piaulet-Ghorayeb et al. 2024 (2024ApJ...974L..10P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PIAULET_GHORAYEB_ET_AL__2024): P 6.20183 d

charts.title: GJ 9827 d: its transit
charts.description: GJ 9827 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (42, 70, 92) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 301289516, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 5-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
